title: TechnoPack
description: A modpack combining industry, exploration, city-building, and interdimensional travel, optimized for smooth adventure.
body:
## 🌍 TechnoPack — Industry, Exploration & Civilization (Minecraft 1.20.1)

Welcome to **TechnoPack**, a universe where engineering meets adventure.
Dig deep into the earth to extract precious resources, refine ores, and build powerful mechanical tools, complex machines, data networks — and yes, even **trains**. Progress through technology, master automation, and eventually unlock **interdimensional travel** to shape entire worlds your way.

Crank up industry with **massive quarries**, navigate the world by rail, build futuristic **storage networks** spanning the universe, and engineer everything from tiny gadgets to massive contraptions.

But industry isn’t everything. When the gears quiet down, **nature awaits**.
Explore stunning new biomes, uncover fresh structures, and enjoy a beautiful, smooth world generation full of life, mystery, and breathtaking landscapes.

### 🏛️ Civilization Features

👶 Want a family? You can.
🏙️ Want a kingdom? Build one.
Invite friends, rise to power, create laws, set taxes, grow cities, form families, and leave behind a **lasting legacy**.

### ⚙️ Optimized Adventure

Despite nearly 100 mods, TechnoPack is polished for smooth gameplay — automation, exploration, and huge builds without sacrificing stability.

---

This modpack was originally made for my friends and me —
so enjoy the chaos, expect a few rough edges, and most of all… **have fun!** 😄
